#to make the .csv that feeds into cell profiler 
```{r}
path <- "/Users/compt/SynologyDrive/iPSC-hepatocyte experiment/Staining/D10 (ch0=dapi, ch1=afp, ch2=hnf, ch3=alb)/raw images/"
files <- list.files(
  path         = path,
  pattern      = "\\.tif$",
  recursive    = TRUE,   # <-- goes into slide1_female/, slide2_male/
  full.names   = TRUE    # <-- keeps the full path so we can extract folder name
)
pattern <- "^(.*?)(?:[_ ]n(\\d+))?[_ ]c(\\d+)-(\\d+)_ch(\\d+)$"

df <- tibble(filepath = files) %>%
  mutate(
    fname = basename(filepath) %>% str_remove("\\.tif$"),
    parts = str_match(fname, pattern),
    condition = str_trim(parts[, 2]),
    n         = as.integer(parts[, 3]),   # NA if the file has no _n#
    coverslip = as.integer(parts[, 4]),
    image     = as.integer(parts[, 5]),
    channel   = as.integer(parts[, 6]),
    slide = str_extract(filepath, "(?i)slide\\s?\\d+") %>%
      str_extract("\\d+") %>%
      as.integer(),
    sex = str_extract(filepath, "(?i)(female|male)") %>% str_to_lower()
  ) %>%
  select(-parts)

df %>% filter(is.na(channel) | is.na(condition)) %>% pull(fname)
# Add channel info
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    stain = case_when(
      channel == 0 ~ "DNA",
      channel == 1 ~ "AFP",
      channel == 2 ~ "HNFa4",
      channel == 3 ~ "Albumin"
    )
  )

# Reshape for CP — one image per row
df_cp <- df %>%
  mutate(
    FileName = basename(filepath),
    PathName = dirname(normalizePath(filepath))                 
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(coverslip, image, condition, slide, sex),
    names_from = stain,
    values_from = c(FileName, PathName),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{stain}"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("Metadata_", .), c(coverslip, image, condition, slide, sex))

# Clean up
df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  rename_with(~gsub(" ", "", .))

df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ sapply(., `[`, 1)))

sapply(df_cp, class)

#each slide should be run seprately in fluerecence chnages
df_cp %>%
  group_split(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex) %>%
  walk(~{
    slide_id <- unique(.x$Metadata_slide)
    sex_id <- unique(.x$Metadata_sex)
    
    write_csv(.x, paste0("/Users/compt/SynologyDrive/iPSC-hepatocyte experiment/Staining/D10 (ch0=dapi, ch1=afp, ch2=hnf, ch3=alb)/Metadata/metadata_slide_", slide_id, sex_id, ".csv"))
  })

```

# Load Nuclei.csv and Cytoplasm.csv from every slide folder
```{r}
# Read one CellProfiler CSV that has a two-row header
read_cp_combined <- function(f) {
  hdr  <- read_csv(f, n_max = 2, col_names = FALSE,
                   col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
  obj  <- unlist(hdr[1, ], use.names = FALSE)   # Image / Nuclei / Cytoplasm
  meas <- unlist(hdr[2, ], use.names = FALSE)   # AreaShape_Area, Math_Alb_ratio, ...

  # In case the object name is only written at the start of each block
  for (i in seq_along(obj)[-1]) {
    if (is.na(obj[i]) || obj[i] == "") obj[i] <- obj[i - 1]
  }

  nm <- make.unique(paste(obj, meas, sep = "_"))
  read_csv(f, skip = 2, col_names = nm,
           show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 10000)
}

# Loop over the Slide folders
load_cp <- function(path, file = "Nuclei.csv", slide = NULL) {
  if (is.null(slide)) {
    slide <- list.dirs(path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
    slide <- slide[str_detect(slide, "^Slide")]
  }
  map_dfr(slide, function(s) {
    f <- file.path(path, s, file)
    message("Reading: ", f)
    read_cp_combined(f) %>% mutate(slide_folder = s)
  })
}

cells <- load_cp(cell_profiler_input_path, file = "Nuclei.csv")

# Columns now carry an object prefix, so drop the ^ from the pattern
grep("Classify_|Math_", names(cells), value = TRUE)
```

# Turn the Classify_ columns into one class column
```{r}
class_levels <- c(
  "HNF4a+/Alb+/AFP+",
  "HNF4a+/Alb+/AFP-",
  "HNF4a+/Alb-/AFP+",
  "HNF4a+/Alb-/AFP-",
  "HNF4a-/Alb+/AFP+",
  "HNF4a-/Alb+/AFP-",
  "HNF4a-/Alb-/AFP+",
  "Non-Hepatocyte"          # HNF4a-/Alb-/AFP-
)

pos_cols <- c("Nuclei_Classify_HNF4a_pos",
              "Cytoplasm_Classify_Alb_pos",
              "Cytoplasm_Classify_AFP_pos")

missing_cols <- setdiff(pos_cols, names(cells))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Not found: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "\nCheck with grep('Classify_', names(cells), value = TRUE)")
}

# How many cells have no call for a marker (e.g. a NaN ratio)?
print(colSums(is.na(cells[pos_cols])))

sign <- function(x) if_else(x, "+", "-")

cells <- cells %>%
  mutate(
    hnf4a_pos = coalesce(Nuclei_Classify_HNF4a_pos == 1, FALSE),
    alb_pos   = coalesce(Cytoplasm_Classify_Alb_pos == 1, FALSE),
    afp_pos   = coalesce(Cytoplasm_Classify_AFP_pos == 1, FALSE),
    class = if_else(
      !hnf4a_pos & !alb_pos & !afp_pos,
      "Non-Hepatocyte",
      paste0("HNF4a", sign(hnf4a_pos),
             "/Alb",  sign(alb_pos),
             "/AFP",  sign(afp_pos))
    ),
    class = factor(class, levels = class_levels)
  )

count(cells, class)

```

# Summaries: image -> slide -> sex
```{r}
# Step 1: percent of each class per image (classes absent from an image = 0%)
class_image <- cells %>%
  count(Image_Metadata_sex, Image_Metadata_slide, Image_Metadata_coverslip, Image_ImageNumber, class, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(Image_Metadata_sex, Image_Metadata_slide, Image_Metadata_coverslip, Image_ImageNumber) %>%
  filter(sum(n) > 0) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: mean across images within each coverslip
class_coverslip <- class_image %>%
  group_by(Image_Metadata_sex, Image_Metadata_slide, Image_Metadata_coverslip, class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent),
    n_images     = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: mean across images within each slide
class_slide <- class_coverslip %>%
  group_by(Image_Metadata_sex, Image_Metadata_slide, class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(mean_percent),
    n_coverslips     = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: mean, SD and SE across slides within each sex
class_summary <- class_slide %>%
  group_by(Image_Metadata_sex, class) %>%
  summarise(
    grand_mean = mean(mean_percent),
    sd         = sd(mean_percent),
    n_slides   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n_slides))

class_summary
```

# Shared plot style
```{r}
# Stacked plot: classes grouped into developmental stages
class_groups <- tribble(
  ~class,              ~stage,
  "Non-Hepatocyte",    "Non-hepatic",
  "HNF4a+/Alb-/AFP-",  "Hepatic progenitor",
  "HNF4a+/Alb-/AFP+",  "Hepatic progenitor",
  "HNF4a+/Alb+/AFP+",  "Immature hepatocyte",
  "HNF4a+/Alb+/AFP-",  "Mature-like hepatocyte",
  "HNF4a-/Alb+/AFP+",  "HNF4a\u2212 atypical",
  "HNF4a-/Alb+/AFP-",  "HNF4a\u2212 atypical",
  "HNF4a-/Alb-/AFP+",  "HNF4a\u2212 atypical"
)

stage_levels <- c("Non-hepatic", "Hepatic progenitor", "Immature hepatocyte",
                  "Mature-like hepatocyte", "HNF4a\u2212 atypical")

# Shades grouped by stage, so the pieces within each bar look related
class_colors <- c(
  "Non-Hepatocyte"   = "grey70",
  "HNF4a+/Alb-/AFP-" = "#0d0887",
  "HNF4a+/Alb-/AFP+" = "#5c01a6",
  "HNF4a+/Alb+/AFP+" = "#9c179e",
  "HNF4a+/Alb+/AFP-" = "#cc4778",
  "HNF4a-/Alb+/AFP+" = "#ed7953",
  "HNF4a-/Alb+/AFP-" = "#fdb42f",
  "HNF4a-/Alb-/AFP+" = "#f0f921"
)


p_class <- ggplot(class_summary,
                  aes(x = class, y = grand_mean, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(grand_mean - se, 0), ymax = grand_mean + se),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = class_slide,
    aes(x = class, y = mean_percent, color = class),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
    size = 3, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Image_Metadata_sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))) +
  labs(y = "% of nuclei", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_class

class_stage <- class_summary %>%
  mutate(class = as.character(class)) %>%
  left_join(class_groups, by = "class") %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = stage_levels),
         class = factor(class, levels = names(class_colors)))


p_stacked <- ggplot(class_stage,
                    aes(x = stage, y = grand_mean, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, position = position_stack(),
           colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Image_Metadata_sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Phenotype", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(y = "% of nuclei", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

p_stacked


# class breakdown for each slide (spot outlier slides)
p_per_slide <- ggplot(class_slide,
                      aes(x = Image_Metadata_slide, y = mean_percent, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, position = position_stack()) +
  facet_grid(~ Image_Metadata_sex, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Phenotype") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(y = "% of nuclei", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() 

p_per_slide
```
